property_summary: For any short (isLong=false) order, fillOrder must record the position expiration under the opposite (position) id, leaving positionExpirations[uint256(orderHash)] == 0; the mutant wrongly stores it under the order hash, so the getter returns a nonzero value for the order hash.
change_summary: Always key the expiration by uint256(orderHash) instead of the conditional, so short orders record the expiration under the order hash rather than the opposite (position) id.
